meaning.en: (uncountable) The purchasing department of a company.
meaning.vi: (không đếm được) Bộ phận mua hàng của một công ty.

meaning.en: (countable) The act of procuring or obtaining; obtainment; attainment.
meaning.vi: (đếm được) Hành động mua sắm hoặc có được; sự đạt được; đạt được.
Liên quan hiệu quả; sự quản lý; đại lý.

meaning.en: Procurement is the act of getting something, particularly military supplies.
meaning.vi: Mua sắm là hành động nhận một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là vật tư quân sự.

meaning_vi: sự kiếm được, sự thu được, sự mua được

sentences.en: Among the grounds on which a divorce may be obtained are adultery, extreme cruelty, fraud, abandonment for three years, gross neglect of duty, habitual drunkenness, a former existing marriage, procurement of divorce without the state by one party, which continues marriage binding on the other, and imprisonment in a penitentiary.

sentences.en: Furthermore, he called for the integration of military command and administration, and demanded greater transparency in military procurement.

sentences.en: The book looks at procurement not so much from the legal contract as from the general contractual arrangements.

sentences.en: But above all, and whatever the constraints, you must have a can-do, innovative approach to procurement.

sentences.en: In the case of complex procurement, these often require considerable tailoring to meet the needs of the particular procurement.
